national_news.title: Screen Reader Access
bullets: Midday News On Air website complies with World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.0 level AA.
Enables people with visual impairments to access the website using assistive technologies, such as screen readers.
List of accessible screen readers:
- Windows narrator (Windows only)
- Non Visual Desktop Access (NVDA)
- System Access To Go
- Thunder

national_news.title: Parliament passes Bankers’ Books Evidence Bill to recognise digital banking records as legal evidence
bullets: Parliament has passed the Bankers’ Books Evidence Bill, 2026
The Bill aims to modernise the legal framework to meet the requirements of the present banking system
It seeks to provide a law relating to evidence with respect to bankers’ books and align it with contemporary digital banking practices
An electronic or digital record of a banker’s book will be admissible as evidence

national_news.title: LS passes Tribunals Reforms Bill, aims to improve transparency & efficiency of Tribunals
bullets: Lok Sabha has passed the Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026.
The Bill aims to improve efficiency, ensure independence, transparency, and uniformity in the qualifications, appointment of service of Chairpersons and Members.

national_news.title: 43 Union Minister Kiren Rijiju appeals to opposition to allow HM Amit Shah to make statement
bullets: Government ready for detailed discussion in Parliament regarding student protests and related issues
Home Minister Amit Shah to respond to every point
Opposition urged to maintain order and refrain from obstructing proceedings

national_news.title: India scripted successful conservation journey from 523 lions to 891 in last 10 years: PM Modi on World Lion Day
bullets: India's Asiatic lion population is thriving, with its habitat and range expanding.
Government's commitment to conservation, backed by community participation, is an inspiring example of protecting wildlife.
Lions' range has expanded from around 30 square kilometers to 20,000 square kilometers in the last decade.

national_news.title: Over ten lakh people evacuated as typhoon Dolphin batters parts of Eastern China
bullets: More than one million people evacuated from eastern China, including Shanghai.
Typhoon Dolphin brought heavy rain and disrupted transport across the region.
Nearly 1,000 flights were cancelled in Shanghai.
Authorities have downgraded Dolphin to a tropical storm.
China issued its highest-level red alert for Dolphin, the strongest storm to hit the country this year.

national_news.title: Former IRGC Chief Mohsen Rezaee appointed as Iran Supreme Leader’s representative to SNSC
bullets: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei has appointed former IRGC chief Mohsen Rezaee as his representative to the country's Supreme National Security Council (SNSC).
Mohsen Rezaee replaces Mohammad Baqir Zolghadr in the position.
Rezaee is a former IRGC chief and a member of Iran's Expediency Discernment Council.

national_news.title: Russia Proposes Rail Route to India to reduce dependence on strategically important maritime routes
bullets: Russia proposes exploring a railway route to the Indian Ocean and India to reduce dependence on strategically important maritime routes.
Alternative routes could help address risks associated with the two strategic waterways including the Strait of Hormuz and the Bosphorus Strait.
Rail routes passing through Turkmenistan, Iran, and Afghanistan could be explored to provide access to India.

national_news.title: India secures two medals at World Athletics U20 Championships in US
bullets: Basant Kumar Meghwal won silver in men's high jump with a personal best clearance of 2.21 metres.
Shahnavaz Khan claimed bronze in men's long jump with a best effort of 7.84 metres.
This is the first time Indians have won medals in high jump and long jump at the championships.

national_news.title: Maharajan Arumugapandian clinches Silver medal at Asian Junior Weightlifting Championships
bullets: Indian weightlifter Maharajan Arumugapandian won the silver medal in the men’s 65-kilogram category
Won at the Asian Junior Weightlifting Championships in Tashkent, Uzbekistan
Produced a personal best total of 285 kilograms, lifting 128 kilograms in the snatch and 157 kilograms in the clean and jerk

national_news.title: Asian Junior Weightlifting Championships: Maharajan Arumugapandian Clinches Silver
bullets: Indian weightlifter Maharajan Arumugapandian clinched the silver medal in the men’s 65 kg category at the Asian Junior Weightlifting Championships in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.
Maharajan produced a new personal best total of 285 kilograms, lifting 128 kg in the snatch and 157 kg in the clean and jerk to secure silver.
Vietnam’s Hoang Thach claimed the gold medal with a total lift of 291 kilograms, finishing six kilograms ahead of Maharajan.

national_news.title: Physical Challans Dispensed with for Voluntary Duty Payments
bullets: DGFT has removed the requirement of submitting physical duty payment challans for Export Obligation Discharge Certificates (EODC).
Exporters will no longer be required to submit physical challans for voluntary duty payments made on or after 1st of this month.
The measure aims to speed up processing, reduce avoidable correspondence, and ensure greater efficiency.
